display.purpose: Brand, page titles, decision and workout headlines.

data.purpose: Dates, measurements and short evidence labels.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and drawers only; page sections remain flat.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Short hover, focus and decision state transitions; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Mint navigation rail
components.description: Two-line brand and dark active destination on the mint rail.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:grid;align-content:start;gap:10px;width:142px;padding:24px 14px;background:var(--color-rail-mint,#bde8c9);color:var(--color-rail-ink,#163c29);font-family:'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif}.ds-rail strong{font:700 29px/.94 'DM Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-bottom:18px}.ds-rail strong span{display:block}.ds-rail a{display:block;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:9px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-size:12px}.ds-rail a:hover,.ds-rail a:focus-visible{background:#a8d9b5}.ds-rail .ds-rail-active{background:#28573b;color:#f3faf4}

components.name: Seven-day schedule
components.description: A seven-cell schedule strip with the current athlete-local day filled in green.
components.css: .ds-week{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));background:var(--color-mint-track,#17291e);color:var(--color-ink-green,#eaf5ed);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line-mint,#47664e);font-family:'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif}.ds-week>div{text-align:center;padding:14px 3px;border-right:1px solid var(--color-line-mint,#47664e)}.ds-week>div:last-child{border:0}.ds-week strong{display:block;font:600 15px 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace}.ds-week span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--color-muted-green,#b5d2bd)}.ds-week .ds-week-current{background:#315f3f}.ds-week .ds-week-current span{color:#eaf5ed}

components.name: Split decision plane
components.description: Decision and workout share one canvas and one vertical rule.
components.html:
JOHNNY 建議 / 今日判斷

保守執行

今天先維持輕鬆節奏。

TODAY'S SESSION / 今日課表

8 KM EASY

輕鬆跑 · 6:20–6:40 /km
components.css: .ds-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:var(--color-mint-track,#17291e);color:var(--color-ink-green,#eaf5ed);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line-mint,#47664e);font-family:'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif}.ds-split section{padding:24px}.ds-split section:first-child{border-right:1px solid var(--color-line-mint,#47664e)}.ds-split small{font:600 11px 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:var(--color-muted-green,#b5d2bd)}.ds-split h2{font:700 38px/1.1 'DM Sans','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif;margin:12px 0}.ds-split section:first-child h2{color:var(--color-split-amber,#efbc76)}.ds-split p{font-size:13px;margin:0}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-split section:first-child{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line-mint,#47664e)}}

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Mint filled action on the dark canvas.

components.name: Ruled evidence row
components.description: Three aligned values with source and explanation on the same canvas.
components.css: .ds-evidence{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 105px 1.25fr;gap:12px;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--color-line-mint,#47664e);background:var(--color-mint-track,#17291e);color:var(--color-ink-green,#eaf5ed);font:12px 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif}.ds-evidence strong{font:600 14px 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace}.ds-evidence em{font-style:normal;color:var(--color-muted-green,#b5d2bd)}

components.name: Form field
components.description: Dark, legible input that keeps the product palette in forms.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--color-muted-green,#b5d2bd);font:13px 'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif}.ds-field input{padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--color-line-mint,#47664e);border-radius:9px;background:var(--color-mint-surface,#1d3525);color:var(--color-ink-green,#eaf5ed);font:inherit}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-split-amber,#efbc76);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.northStar: Morning Start Line on Split Board
narrative.overview: A daily running decision on a continuous dark green canvas. A mint navigation rail, seven-day schedule, large decision and workout typography, and fine rules make the day's action easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Seven-day schedule above a shared decision plane
Dividers and typography instead of floating cards

rules.name: One decision plane
rules.body: The decision, today's workout, evidence and plan footer stay in one uninterrupted Today surface.

rules.name: Truthful schedule
rules.body: Show scheduled workouts from the current Plan Version. Mark dates without a schedule as pending unless a planned rest day is known.

dos: Use the mint rail, seven-day strip and ruled Split Board on Today.
Keep action labels tied to real destinations.
donts: Do not use independent white cards, shadows or decorative grids for standard page sections.
Do not invent schedule entries from activity history.
